testcase.name: Micro6 status polling rejects a confirmed task identity mismatch
Micro6 status polling resolves target-specific run status
runScriptAndWait returns RECONCILING (not FAILED) on ambiguous execute timeout
Micro6 conflict whose polled task identity mismatches rejects attachment
Micro6 conflict with mismatched task_key fails closed as DUPLICATE_OR_CONFLICTING_DISPATCH
Micro6 execute with a mismatched task identity fails closed
Micro6 conflict whose polled status is not attachable rejects attachment
Micro6 execute accepts a display name that resolves to the canonical task key via the catalog
Micro6 execute task identity rejects a whitespace mismatch
Micro6 execute with a mismatched entry id fails closed
Micro6 execute task identity rejects a prefix collision (FISHING vs FISHING_TRAINING)
Micro6 conflict whose polled entry id mismatches fails closed as conflicting dispatch
Micro6 backend handles execute endpoint rejection
Micro6 conflict with invalid existing_entry_id fails closed
Micro6 publish returns RECONCILING when execute times out twice and no acceptance is confirmed
Micro6 conflict on a PAUSED existing entry is attachable
Micro6 publish attaches to a verified already-queued run after a 409 conflict
Micro6 backend dispatches to targeted advertised base URL when provided
Micro6 execute task identity rejects a suffix collision (FISHING_TRAINING vs FISHING)
Micro6 execute accepts only a matching immutable settings receipt
Micro6 executor health reports publish-ready when logged in and AccountBuilder is ready
Micro6 backend returns FAILED terminal status with error message
Micro6 execute task identity rejects a case-only mismatch
Micro6 status polling fails closed when iteration identity is missing
Micro6 backend returns COMPLETED terminal status
Micro6 conflict whose poll never confirms identity enters RECONCILING
Micro6 conflict with unknown snapshot status never attaches on a later runnable poll
Micro6 publish keeps command provenance separate from click telemetry
Micro6 publish returns accepted entry id without waiting for completion
Micro6 status polling requires the exact task and iteration identity
Micro6 executor health reports concrete dispatch reason when logged in but startup is incomplete
Micro6 health uses account name fallback only with canonical actual identity
Micro6 execute HTTP 200 with a malformed body is not marked published
Micro6 backend returns timeout terminal result when no terminal status arrives
Micro6 conflict missing identity fields fails closed (never attaches on entry id alone)
Micro6 execute rejects a display name that does not resolve through the catalog resolver
Micro6 execute task identity accepts an exact normalized task_key match
